title: Offboard employee
summary: Process an employee departure including final paycheck, benefits termination, account deactivation, and equity handling.

parts.title: Process the termination in your payroll platform
parts.guidance: Reconcile the departure decision, employing entity, work location, last working day and employment end date with the people lead. Obtain the locally reviewed process before scheduling termination in payroll. Give payroll the effective date, final-pay instructions and unresolved benefits or settlement items. Select the relevant country route; changing a system record does not complete the underlying employment process.

options.title: Default — Process the termination in your payroll platform
options.summary: Use the payroll-system route after the people lead has settled the departure process for the work location. Reconcile the last working day, employment end date and final-pay instructions before applying the authorized change. Check its effect on scheduled payroll and benefits tasks. Follow up on remaining settlement items separately from the system’s termination status.

options.title: India - notice, gratuity, F&F
options.summary: Give local counsel and payroll the employee’s work state, establishment type, service history, contract and departure reason. Determine the required process, notice and final settlement under current law, including applicable gratuity and leave treatment. Resolve the calculation and employee communication before issuing termination instructions. Check the current eligibility rules and exceptions against the employee’s service history and circumstances.

references.title: India Ministry of Labour: Labour Codes

options.title: UK - fair reason + Acas process
options.summary: Review the departure reason, employment terms and applicable procedure with the people lead and adviser before setting the exit date. Prepare the relevant evidence, meetings or consultation, notice and final-pay calculation. The authorized decision maker settles the outcome and employee communication, including any appeal route. Resolve disputed facts through the employment process before sending the final instructions to payroll.
options.when: Offboarding an employee in the United Kingdom

references.title: Acas: Following a fair dismissal procedure
Acas: Dismissals with and without notice

options.title: Germany - KSchG + wet-ink notice
options.summary: Have local counsel assess the contract, service period, establishment circumstances and any employee-representation or special protections. Prepare the appropriate notice and delivery method, including the written-form requirement. The employer’s authorized representative signs through the permitted process. Use the reviewed effective date for payroll and access changes, resolving notice or delivery questions before treating the departure as complete.

options.title: France - rupture conventionnelle
options.summary: Consider rupture conventionnelle only where local advice confirms it fits the contract and both parties freely choose mutual termination. Prepare the agreement, indemnity calculation and procedural calendar, including the applicable administrative review. Track those stages before treating the end date as final. A protected employee requires the distinct authorization procedure, and this route does not cover every French departure.

parts.title: Calculate final paycheck + PTO payout
parts.guidance: Calculate the proposed final pay from recorded hours, salary, unused leave, expenses, bonuses and other agreed amounts. Have the local payroll specialist resolve payability, permitted deductions and payment timing for the actual contract and location. Present an itemized calculation for payment approval and explain discrepancies to the people lead. Keep disputed amounts separate from items ready for payment.

parts.title: Terminate benefits
parts.guidance: List the employee’s active plans and ask the benefits administrator to determine coverage end dates, continuation rights and required notices from the actual departure facts. Coordinate the authorized changes with payroll deductions and communicate the confirmed coverage details and support contact to the employee. Resolve rejected changes and missing notices so the employee knows when coverage ends and what choices remain.

parts.title: Deactivate the email account
parts.guidance: Agree the account cutoff with the people and security leads. Identify mail, calendars and files that need a business custodian, and address retention or legal holds before deleting anything. At the authorized time, restrict sign-in and revoke sessions through the workspace’s supported process. Transfer necessary business information and check the mail-routing arrangement while respecting the former employee’s privacy.

parts.title: Remove from the team chat
parts.guidance: Identify the employee’s chat accounts, shared external workspaces, channel ownership and integrations. Transfer responsibilities that need a continuing owner, then remove access at the agreed departure time through the workspace administrator. Check membership status afterward and contact any external workspace administrator whose action is still needed. Preserve conversation history according to the company’s retention arrangements.

parts.title: Remove from the code hosting org
parts.guidance: Review code-hosting memberships, repository ownership, access tokens and automation tied to the departing person. Transfer maintainership and deployment responsibilities before the agreed access cutoff. The responsible administrator removes memberships and addresses remaining credentials, then checks for access paths outside the main organization. Assign service-account or release ownership gaps to an engineer who can maintain the affected automation and release process.

parts.title: Notify about equity exercise window
parts.guidance: Have the equity administrator and counsel review the person’s actual awards, vesting, departure terms and plan documents. Prepare an individualized notice with verified exercise dates, instructions and a contact for questions. Release the notice after the equity owner checks it against the award records. Track delivery and any disputed terms separately from the employee’s decision whether to exercise.

parts.title: Collect company property
parts.guidance: Compare the asset register with the employee’s actual equipment, security keys, cards and other company property. Agree a return method and contact, arranging shipping for remote returns where needed. Check serial numbers and condition on receipt, and distinguish returned items from transfers or unresolved losses. Send remaining issues to the people lead; a missing item does not by itself authorize a payroll deduction.

geoNotes.summary: Offboarding is governed by state shops-and-establishments acts and central law: contractual/statutory notice, gratuity if service crossed five years, leave encashment, and a clean full-and-final settlement — 'at will' does not exist.
Dismissal is procedural, not at-will: a fair reason and a fair process (the Acas code), statutory notice periods, and final pay including accrued holiday — tribunals police shortcuts.

The Kündigungsschutzgesetz protects employees after six months in companies with more than ten staff: dismissal needs a legally recognized ground and a WET-INK signed notice letter (electronic form is invalid) — severance deals are the common exit.

The standard amicable exit is the rupture conventionnelle: a signed agreement with a mandatory indemnity, a 15-day withdrawal period, and homologation by the labour administration — unilateral licenciement demands strict cause and procedure.

metadata.supportReason: Gusto handles final paycheck and benefits termination. Account deactivation across systems partially automatable. Equity exercise window needs person-routing.
